# What MAG knows, and what it does not

*Generated by `engine/mechanics_coverage.js`. Do not hand-edit — re-run it.*

Format `gen9championsvgc2026regmb`. Abilities are restricted to species with non-zero usage and weighted by
usage share, so a rare ability on a common Pokémon outranks a common one nobody brings.

**Coverage is reported per channel, not by grep.** `board.js` names almost nothing — it reads
dex fields and probes dex handlers — so searching for an ability name reports nearly everything
as missing. That is exactly how Armor Tail and Queenly Majesty came to be listed as absent when
both were already modelled at 99%.

## Caveats, so this is not over-read

- A channel means the mechanic is *reachable*, not that it is correct. `feature_coverage.js`
  answers whether a feature ever fires; this answers whether a mechanic has a route at all.
- `damage` and `named in board` are detected by searching source for the id, so an ability
  handled generically will show fewer channels than it really has. The bias is toward
  **under**-reporting coverage, which is the safe direction for a gap list.
- Usage share is of the whole format, so shares do not sum to 100% across a filtered table.
